messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - Billing metering anomaly detected. Token-count drift > 18% vs baseline for 'emitter-eu'. Alert ID: A-174321.
alice-oncall: acked. jumping in. seeing error spikes on emitter-eu-0.
carla-sre: noted. I can see Redis ack backlog and a few 5xxs from emitter. attaching quick logs snippet:
carla-sre: ```
[2026-02-14T03:40:01Z] emitter-eu-0 ERROR publish failed: timeout writing to kafka (retry=3)
[2026-02-14T03:40:02Z] emitter-eu-0 WARN ack-lag=120s inflight=240
```
ben-billing: customer-facing metric pipeline shows delayed aggregations. Overages flagged for some customers due to windowed counting hitting thresholds prematurely. I have the list starting to compile.
dani-support: which customers flagged? we have a few open tickets referencing sudden overage emails. need to coordinate comms.
eli-data: preliminary query (rolling 1h) shows pipeline emits delayed by ~6-12 minutes; downstream aggregator applied late windows and counted duplicates in a retry window. Likely cause: emitter retries + delayed dedupe.
alice-oncall: plan: 1) throttle emitter retry backoff to reduce duplicates, 2) swap to fallback emitter image (no-retry) for eu pool, 3) stop automated overage alerting for 15m while we scrub. doing step 1 now.
carla-sre: runbook step 2 ready. image tag: rwd/emitter:fallback-20260214. command: ```kubectl set image deploy/emitter-eu rwd/emitter=rwd/emitter:fallback-20260214 -n prod-eu```  applying in 2m.
ben-billing: pausing overage triggers now (billing-run-alerts -> paused for scope: eu-emits) and marking current flags TTL=30m. will attach affected customer ids.
dani-support: I'm drafting a short message for affected customers: "We're investigating incorrect usage notifications; if you received an overage email between 03:35-03:55 UTC, please ignore — we'll reconcile and credit any incorrect charges." Want approval before sending.
frank-product: +1 send after we confirm scrub steps. also cc key accounts.
alice-oncall: emitter retry throttle applied (backoff_multiplier -> 4x) confirmed. observed immediate drop in inflight retries.
eli-data: running dedupe job to rescan 15m window and mark duplicate token events. ETA ~10m. I'll output list of likely duplicate token increments.
carla-sre: fallback image rollout started. currently 2/4 pods updated, readiness checks passing.
ben-billing: preliminary list: 12 customers flagged (ids: C_1123, C_1456, C_1999, C_2033...). none are enterprise SLA customers. total potential overcount ~ +0.9% of daily tokens but concentrated in small accounts.
dani-support: opening a ticket template for each flagged customer and enqueueing manual credits if needed.
alice-oncall: switching incident channel to live mitigation. please keep short updates. next: if dedupe job completes and we see expected normalization, we'll cancel the paused alerts and issue customer note.
carla-sre: dedupe job complete. cleaned ~58k duplicate token events. emitter backlog reduced to normal.
eli-data: post-scrub checks: token-count drift now ~0.8% (within noise). downstream windows reconciled.
ben-billing: cleared most overage flags; remaining 3 customers still show transient flags due to delayed batch. I'll scrub those manually and queue credits.
dani-support: customer comms approved. sending targeted emails to 12 customers now. template: "We experienced a transient billing telemetry issue; any incorrect usage notifications were in error and will be reversed. No action required"
frank-product: please include a brief postmortem link when available.
alice-oncall: moving to recovery state. handoff to next oncall (ben) in 30m. action items: (alice) follow up with emitter team on retry semantics, (carla) add readiness gating for emitter to avoid partial rollout duplication, (eli) add dedupe sanity check reports to console, (ben) finalize credits and close customer tickets.
ben-billing: ack handoff. I'll own credits and follow up in afternoon triage.
incident-bot: Incident A-174321 -> RESOLVED (mitigated). Duration: 00:45:20. Severity: P2 (billing noise).
carla-sre: quick note: root cause appears to be a recent retry tuning change that decreased retry jitter. follow-up created: GH#3421.
frank-product: thanks team. please tag this for postmortem and add to monthly billing incidents rollup. :thumbsup:
